title: Zapier OAuth connection fails because the token response nests access_token inside an object
symptoms: Connection test fails right after a successful OAuth consent
Refresh works in Postman but not in the integration
cause: Zapier stores only top-level keys from the token response in authData. Nested objects cannot be stored, so tokens under a data or token key are lost.
fix: Switch the token and refresh requests to code mode and return the tokens at the top level.
apply:
const r = await z.request({ url: tokenUrl, method: 'POST', body });
return { access_token: r.data.token.access_token, refresh_token: r.data.token.refresh_token };
affected: Zapier Platform UI and CLI OAuth2 integrations, as of 2026-10
